heroHeadline: De la Espriella to Eliminate Peace Commissioner Office as Transition Dispute Simmers
heroSubtitle: President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella — who won Colombia's June 21 runoff by history's narrowest margin (49.66% to 48.70%) amid fraud allegations from outgoing President Petro that international observers rejected — announced he will cut 229 government posts, including the Office of the High Commissioner for Peace that has run Petro's Total Peace negotiations, as his incoming cabinet takes shape ahead of the August 7 inauguration.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, Registraduría Nacional, and major international outlets.
